purpose: Test a Torch-only NQC matching-matrix derivative counterfactual after the stationary orbital-peak control, using degree-four local polynomials over plus/minus 2 M for all three amplitude-product columns and both phase-basis columns while retaining the natural-cubic right-hand side and output interpolation.
interpretation: This is a Torch-only numerical counterfactual and deliberately breaks Torch/JAX source-path parity. A convergence pass would make this derivative policy a candidate for separate source-fidelity, backend parity, physical accuracy, and domain validation; it would not qualify a release.
